text: StudyGate is an R package that checks clinical analysis datasets before analysis.
Two synthetic studies. Adult: age in years, a thirty-day window. Pediatric: age in months, a fourteen-day window. Same package, different specifications. Study B passes.
In Study A, one adverse event belongs to a subject missing from the subject-level dataset. The gate blocks release, and explains why, what to check, and how to see the row in R.
Once the data query is answered, one documented correction goes onto a copy of the source data. The same twenty-one rules run again, and the gate passes.
The rules are versioned with a change log. Eighty tests pass, and each run records hashes of the spec and the data.
The same result is exported as an HTML report, ready for code review.
One rule set drives validation, the release gate, and programmer guidance. All data are synthetic.
